description: Implementation of memory management functions for the Starboard platform, including allocation, reallocation, deallocation, and reporting functions with version-based conditional compilation.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of given size using internal implementation.

methods.name: SbMemoryReallocate
methods.description: Reallocates memory with size, with version check.

methods.name: SbMemoryDeallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory, ensuring report happens first.

methods.name: SbMemoryReallocateChecked
methods.description: Reallocates memory and aborts on failure.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateAlignedChecked
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory and aborts on failure.

methods.name: SbMemoryAllocateChecked
methods.description: Allocates memory and aborts on failure.
